jobs.title: VP, Architecture
jobs.description:
Job Description

Rakuten Kobo brings the best reading experience to millions of readers worldwide. We operate ebook and audiobook storefronts across dozens of markets, build our own eReaders and reading apps, and run a content and technology platform that few companies of our size can match.

Here at Rakuten Kobo Inc. we offer a casual working start-up environment and a group of friendly and talented individuals. Our employees rank us highly in terms of commitment to work/life balance. We realize that for our people to be innovative, creative and passionate they need to feel valued and supported. We believe in rewarding all our employees with competitive salaries, performance based annual bonuses, stock options and training opportunities.

If you’re looking for a company that inspires passion, personal, and professional growth – join Kobo and come help us on our mission of making reading lives better.

The Role

You will lead the architecture function for all of Kobo's products and services, reporting to the CTO and leading a team of four domain architects covering commerce and discovery, purchasing and reading services, eReader platforms, and data engineering.

This is a VP-level leadership role exercised through architecture, not through P&L. You hold decision authority over Kobo's technology architecture — but your leverage comes from setting direction, defining the decision frameworks others use, and making the org better at making good calls without you in the

room. You stay close to the code through design reviews and architecture forums.

The Landscape You'll Shape

Our third-generation ecommerce, ad-tech, marketing automation, and personalization platform, powering storefronts in over 40 geos
Reading experience on iOS and Android apps, on the desktop Webreader, and our eReader devices
A rich content catalog and data model powering search, discovery, and syndication with retail partners

What You'll Do

Lead, grow, and develop the architecture team — four domain architects with coverage across our major technology areas, with hiring authority as the function grows
Run the architecture guild and practice forums. The guild is how architectural change is communicated to the broader engineering org; the practice forums are where major architectural changes and questions get surfaced and stress-tested with our principal and staﬀ engineers and architects.
Grow both into the venue where Kobo's biggest technical decisions are made
Identify gaps in our software ecosystem and drive the roadmap that closes them, in partnership with the CTO
Define the decision rubrics and frameworks that let engineering teams make sound architectural calls autonomously — your influence should scale far beyond your calendar
Champion pragmatic, incremental architecture: reduce complexity, improve velocity and reliability, and keep tactical delivery and long-term evolution moving together

What Success Looks Like (first 12–24 Months)

The architecture guild and practice forums are thriving — well-attended, respected, and the de facto venue where big architectural decisions are communicated and debated
The flagship cross-functional initiatives are advancing or delivered, with architecture playing a visible, decisive role
There is a living, prioritized view of gaps in our software ecosystem, with a roadmap the CTO and R&D leadership team buy into

The Skillset

We are not screening for a specific technology checklist. What's essential:

10+ years building and architecting software, including senior leadership experience (Architect /Principal / Director level) in software development organizations
Deep understanding of how large-scale systems hang together — distributed systems, event-driven architectures, data platforms, and the modern design patterns and frameworks that hold them up
Curiosity and the ability to learn independently — you'll inherit a broad, varied estate, and nobody will hand you a manual
Collaboration and communication — you can facilitate design sessions, deliver training, evangelize technology choices, and earn the trust of engineers more senior in their domains than you areA track record of defining frameworks and decision rubrics that help other people make good calls, rather than hoarding the decisions yourself

Nice To Have (context For Our Environment, Not Requirements)

Experience in ecommerce or ad-tech platforms operating at significant scale, in both real-time and asynchronous workflows
Experience with hybrid environments (own data centre + public cloud)
Breadth across both client platforms and backend services

Working At Kobo

We oﬀer competitive compensation, including salary, bonus, and a comprehensive benefits package. Full details are shared during the hiring process.

Rakuten Kobo is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees. If you require accommodation at any stage of the recruitment process, please let us know — we'll work with you to make sure it's the right experience for you.

The Perks

Flexible hours and hybrid remote working environment
Subsidized in-office lunches
Four extended long weekends in the summer
Full benefits starting from your first day
Paid Volunteer days, unlimited sick days, and 3% RRSP matching
Work From Anywhere Program for up to 3 months (90 days)
Lifestyle spending account
Talent and development training budget
Free Kobo device + free weekly e-book or audiobook
Weekly Kobo Spark sessions
Maternity/paternity leave top up
Dog friendly office

About Rakuten Kobo Inc.

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is the world’s digital bookseller created by and for booklovers. Owned by Tokyo-based Rakuten Group, Inc. and headquartered in Toronto, Rakuten Kobo’s millions of worldwide users can read anytime, anywhere, and on any device. With a mission to make reading lives better for all, Rakuten Kobo connects readers to stories using thoughtful and personalized curation of eBooks and audiobooks, and the best dedicated eReaders and apps for reading. With the singular focus of making reading lives the best they can be, Kobo’s open platform allows people to fit reading into more moments in their busy lives. To learn more about Rakuten Kobo, visit www.kobo.com.

Rakuten Kobo Inc. is an equal opportunity employer. Accessibility accommodations for candidates with disabilities participating in the selection process are available on request. Any information received related to accommodation needs of applicants will be addressed confidentially.  

Rakuten Kobo would like to thank all applicants for their interest in this role however only qualified candidates will be shortlisted.

jobs.title: Audience & Data Strategy Director
jobs.description:
Agency

Omnicom Media

Job Function

Data and Analytics

Job Subfunction

Data Science and Analytics

Job Description

Position Summary

As our new Director, Audience Strategy, you will take on blended agency + client-facing role that incorporates business consulting, analytical depth, and cross-functional leadership.

Serving as a trusted advisor, you will connect client priorities to the right data capabilities (1P, 2P, 3P), technology, and strategy, to help drive measurable business outcomes.
Using your financial accumen and eye for detail you will ensure accurate revenue reporting, campaign pacing, and identify opportunities to grow audience targeting usage
Using your technical expertise and analytics skills you will support a talented team of analysts on segment creation, activation, manage operational issues, and collaborate on the development of new tools that improve the efficiency and effectiveness of our processes.
Leveraging your industry knowledge and leadership skills, you will work with internal product teams and vendors partners to grow our capabilities.

This position requires strong strategic thinking, relationship building and management, presentation, critical thinking, and problem-solving skills.

Key Responsibilities

Audience Strategy

Own the audience narrative for clients and align all work to business priorities and measurable outcomes.
Advise senior stakeholders using data-driven insights across audience strategy, testing, and optimization.
Translate complex signals and technical concepts into clear, actionable recommendations that build confidence with clients, partners, and internal leaders
Support development of client-facing deliverables including segment specifications, activation guides, and performance reports
Evolve and manage client data partnerships to ensure our audience offering stays ahead of customer needs

Audience Execution

Manage audience infrastructure including segment uploads, match rate optimization, and troubleshooting activation issues across DSPs, social platforms, and other endpoints
Maintain documentation of audience build processes, segment definitions, and activation requirements
Support audience modeling projects including clustering, lookalike modeling, propensity scoring, and behavioral segmentation in partnership with Advanced Analytics team
Willingness and ability to be “hands-on” as needed to step in, guide, or support deliverables.

Team Development

Mentor a talented team of 4+
Contribute to internal training materials and knowledge sharing sessions
Support recruitment efforts by participating in interviews and candidate evaluations
Provide technical guidance to junior team members and media planners on audience capabilities and data requirements

Continuous Learning & Innovation

Stay current on audience strategy best practices, emerging technologies, and privacy developments
Pilot new tools, techniques, and data sources to expand team capabilities
Document learnings and contribute to internal process improvements
Explore applications of AI/ML for audience development under senior guidance

Qualifications

Required Experience

7+ years of experience in audience strategy, data strategy, programmatic media, or marketing analytics within agency, brand, or martech environments
Experience managing a multi-million-dollar budget
1-3 years of people management experience
Demonstrated ability to independently execute complex audience projects from data analysis through activation
Direct hands-on experience building audience segments and managing campaign activation across multiple platforms
Proven ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders

Core Competencies

Strong bias toward action with attention to detail and quality
Exceptional presentation and written communication skill
Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects with competing priorities
Works effectively across teams and builds productive relationships
Comfortable with ambiguity and changing priorities in a fast-paced environment

This is an active vacancy. We are currently hiring for this role and reviewing applications on an ongoing basis.

Expected Salary: $105,000 - $115,000

Skills

Omnicom Media is providing the compensation range that the company is willing to pay for this position based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, knowledge, skills and abilities. In addition, Omnicom Media provides rewarding offerings such as:

Generous paid time off with a minimum of 37 paid days off including vacation and monthly wellness days. We also have four-day long weekends, half-day summer Fridays, and meeting-free Friday afternoons year-round.
A flexible hybrid work model that works for you.
A focus on personal development with formal training opportunities, including mental health training and inclusion education for everyone.
A chance to be part of and grow within a global network of agencies.
The opportunity to contribute to our company culture by joining one of our many community-based employee groups, such as Black Employee Network, Girls on Fire, Hispanic or Latinx Alliance, Neuro Network, Pan-Asian Network, and Rainbow Lounge.

Omnicom is an equal opportunity employer, committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, colour, ethnicity, gender, age, religion, creed, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, citizenship, genetic information, disability, or any other basis prohibited by applicable federal, provincial, or municipal law. If you require an accommodation in any aspect of the selection process, please reach out to talentcanada@omnicommedia.com

$105,000 - $115,000

To the extent permissible by local law, Omnicom’s policy requires employees to work in the office for a minimum of three days a week, unless additional in-office days are directed by their agency or manager.

Omnicom is committed to hiring and developing exceptional talent. We agree that talent is uniquely distributed, and we’re focused on developing inclusive teams that can bring the best solutions to everything we do. We strongly believe that celebrating what makes us different makes us better together. Join us—we look forward to getting to know you. We will process your personal data in accordance with our Recruitment Privacy Notice.

jobs.title: Director Supply Chain Strategy
jobs.description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena builds the critical infrastructure powering the AI era. We’re a technology company shaping the future of networking, guided by innovation, integrity, and collaboration. Through development opportunities, meaningful work, and flexibility, Ciena supports growth and well-being—on and off the job. Connect with a career that matters.

The Director, Global Supply Chain Strategy & Architecture
is responsible for defining the long-term strategy and future-state architecture of the global Supply Chain organization.

This leader will translate business growth objectives, product strategy, customer requirements, market dynamics, and external supply-chain trends into an integrated global supply chain strategy and future-state design. The role will define the strategic choices required across the supply chain network, manufacturing and partner ecosystem, capacity, resilience, inventory positioning, and critical capabilities
to ensure the Supply Chain is positioned to scale, respond, and perform as the business evolves.

The Director will serve as the architect and integrator of the end-to-end supply chain
, connecting functional strategies into a cohesive future-state direction, identifying structural and capability requirements, developing strategic scenarios, and establishing the multi-year roadmap required to prepare Supply Chain for future business needs.

Key Responsibilities

Global Supply Chain Strategy
Lead the development and ongoing evolution of the global, multi-year Supply Chain strategy, aligned with the corporate strategy and growth objectives.
Translate business, product, market, and customer strategies into implications for the future supply chain.
Define the strategic choices required across areas such as global footprint, capacity, sourcing, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, supply assurance, resilience, and partner strategy.
Identify the capabilities required to enable the supply chain to scale effectively while maintaining agility, competitiveness, and customer responsiveness.
Maintain an external perspective on geopolitical developments, industry trends, supply-market dynamics, manufacturing models, and emerging supply-chain practices.
Physical Strategic Roadmap & Prioritization
Develop and maintain an integrated 3-5 year Supply Chain strategic roadmap, translating strategy into clear priorities and strategic initiatives.
Establish the strategic rationale and expected business outcomes associated with major supply-chain investments.
Identify dependencies and trade-offs across major strategic initiatives and recommend priorities
Ensure functional strategies connect to a common end-to-end direction rather than developing independently.
Partner with functional leaders to translate the global strategy into actionable priorities within their respective organizations.
Facilitate leadership discussions and strategy sessions focused on major supply-chain choices and priorities.
Establish a regular cadence for reviewing the Supply Chain strategy, external assumptions, strategic risks, and progress against priorities.
Ensure strategic decisions are translated into clear ownership and accountability across the Supply Chain organization.
Supply Chain Network & Ecosystem Strategy
Develop strategic perspectives on the global supply-chain footprint and ecosystem required to support future growth.
Assess long-term requirements for manufacturing capacity, geographic diversification, supplier ecosystem, contract manufacturing, distribution, and logistics networks.
Evaluate strategic make/buy/partner considerations and recommend the appropriate operating model for different elements of the supply chain.
Incorporate geopolitical, concentration, continuity, capacity, cost, and customer considerations into global network decisions.
Partner with functional leaders to develop strategies that strengthen supply assurance and reduce structural supply-chain risk.
Strategic Capacity & Scale Readiness
Assess the supply chain's ability to support future revenue, product, volume, and customer requirements.
Identify structural constraints that could limit the company's ability to scale.
Develop strategic scenarios for different growth, demand, supply, and geopolitical conditions.
Identify where additional capacity, capability, supplier diversification, inventory, or ecosystem investment may be required.
Establish a forward-looking view of supply-chain readiness and bring recommended actions and trade-offs to senior leadership.
Strategic Business & Financial Analysis
Develop fact-based recommendations for complex supply-chain decisions, clearly articulating options, trade-offs, risks, investment requirements, and expected business outcomes.
Develop business cases for significant strategic supply-chain investments and decisions.
Partner with Finance to assess the financial implications of alternative supply-chain strategies.
Balance service, growth, resilience, inventory, working capital, cost, and investment considerations when developing strategic recommendations.
Establish measures that demonstrate whether the supply-chain strategy is delivering the intended business outcomes.
Enterprise & Cross-Functional Alignment
Build strong partnerships across Product Line Management (PLM), R&D, Finance, Sales Operations, and other Enterprise functions.
Connect product roadmaps, business growth plans, financial objectives, and customer requirements to future supply-chain requirements.
Ensure Supply Chain implications are incorporated early into major business and product decisions.

Outside the Scope of This Role

This Role Does Not Own

Digital supply-chain strategy or technology implementation
Process transformation and process redesign
Supply-chain systems implementation
Automation or AI deployment
Transformation program management
Day-to-day functional or operational execution

The Must Haves

Bachelor’s degree in supply chain, Operations, Engineering, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
Significant progressive experience in global supply chain, operations, strategy, or a related leadership role.
Broad end-to-end understanding of supply-chain disciplines including planning, sourcing, manufacturing, inventory, logistics, supplier management, and supply assurance.
Demonstrated ability to develop long-term strategy and translate complex business requirements into clear strategic priorities.
Experience within a complex global manufacturing environment, ideally technology, telecommunications, electronics, semiconductor, or a related sector.
Experience evaluating supply-chain networks, manufacturing strategies, capacity requirements, outsourcing models, and/or global supply ecosystems.
Strong business and financial acumen with experience developing investment recommendations and evaluating strategic trade-offs.
Exceptional executive communication skills and demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders across organizational boundaries.

Nice To Have

MBA or advanced degree in Supply Chain, Operations, Engineering, Finance, or related discipline.
Experience working within an outsourced or contract-manufacturing operating model.
Experience supporting periods of significant business growth or structural change.
Experience with scenario planning, network strategy, supply-chain risk, and global capacity strategy.

Leadership Competencies

Enterprise Thinking: Optimizes decisions for the end-to-end business rather than individual functions.
Strategic Foresight: Anticipates future business requirements and their implications for the supply chain.
Commercial Acumen: Connects supply-chain choices directly to growth, customers and financial outcomes.
Structured Problem Solving: Brings clarity and fact-based thinking to ambiguous strategic issues.
Influence & Alignment: Builds commitment across functions and senior leaders.
Executive Presence: Communicates complex strategic issues simply and confidently.
Decision Orientation: Moves strategy beyond analysis into clear choices, priorities, and accountability.

Pay Ranges

The salary range for this role in Ottawa, Canada is $144, 900 - $231, 500

The salary range for this role in the eastern-USA is $158, 800 - $253, 600

Pay ranges at Ciena are designed to accommodate variations in knowledge, skills, experience, market conditions, and locations, reflecting our diverse products, industries, and lines of business. Please note that the pay range information provided in this posting pertains specifically to the primary location, which is the top location listed in case multiple locations are available.

Non-Sales employees may be eligible for a discretionary incentive bonus, while Sales employees may be eligible for a sales commission. In addition to competitive compensation, Ciena offers a comprehensive benefits package, including medical, dental, and vision plans, participation in 401(K) (USA) & DCPP (Canada) with company matching, Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), Employee Assistance Program (EAP), company-paid holidays, paid sick leave, and vacation time. We also comply with all applicable laws regarding Paid Family Leave and other leaves of absence.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.

Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.

If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

jobs.title: Global Head of Corporate Finance, General Account
jobs.description:
The Head of Corporate Finance is a senior investment leadership role accountable for leading Manulife’s global investment-grade corporate lending activities for the General Account. The role oversees approximately US$163 billion in investments, representing one of the General Account’s largest dedicated investment portfolios.

The Head of Corporate Finance is responsible for delivering strong, sustainable investment performance by identifying attractive relative value across public and private corporate credit markets, maintaining disciplined underwriting and risk management, and deploying capital effectively across Manulife’s global insurance businesses.

Key drivers of the outperformance of our investment program have been our direct contact and relationships with borrowers, our integrated global investment origination model across North America, Europe, Latin America, and Asia Pacific, and our very close partnership with our portfolio managers and credit officers to drive balanced innovation that best fits different Manulife portfolios.

The role leads a global team of approximately 70 lending professionals across Toronto, Boston and London, with an additional 15 lending professionals in Asia operating through a dotted-line relationship.

This leader is also a senior contributor to the broader General Account strategy and investment governance, bringing deep corporate credit expertise, market insight and leadership to enterprise investment decisions.

Position Responsibilities

Market Engagement, Investment Strategy & Performance

Empower your lending officers and teams to be leaders in the marketplace, engaging directly with borrowers and prospective borrowers and peers to understand well the market for investment grade lending and identify emerging sectors and borrowers where we can obtain better risk return in our lending.

Lead the global Corporate Finance investment strategy for an approximately US$163 billion investment-grade lending portfolio supporting the General Account.
Drive sustainable investment performance and attractive risk-adjusted returns for Manulife policyholders and shareholders.
Identify relative value across a highly diversified portfolio encompassing approximately 2,000 corporate borrowers.
Oversee investment activity across both public bonds and private placements, with the portfolio currently comprising approximately 70% public and 30% private investments.
Maintain a strong understanding of industries, companies and market dynamics to inform investment decisions and portfolio positioning.

Global Capital Deployment

Lead corporate lending activity across multiple currencies, including USD, CAD, EUR, GBP, AUD and CHF.
Optimize investment opportunities across Manulife’s global balance sheets, including Manulife Canada, Manulife Asia and John Hancock.
Partner closely with portfolio management teams to align corporate credit origination and investment activity with liability characteristics, portfolio requirements and business priorities.

Credit & Risk Leadership

Maintain disciplined investment underwriting and risk selection across a large and diversified corporate credit portfolio.
Work collaboratively with credit officers and portfolio managers to evaluate credit risk and identify attractive risk-return opportunities.
Bring industry expertise and judgment to complex investment decisions.
Contribute senior investment expertise to broader General Account investment decisions and governance.

Leadership & Talent

Lead a geographically dispersed global Corporate Finance organization across North America, Europe and Asia.
Build a high-performing investment culture characterized by strong judgment, accountability, collaboration, transparency and respect.
Develop leadership and investment capability across the organization and create a strong pipeline of future investment leaders.
Establish clear priorities while empowering senior leaders and investment professionals to operate effectively within their areas of responsibility.

Strategic Leadership

Serve as a senior member of the General Account Leadership Team and General Account Investment Committee.
Contribute to the development of the General Account's broader investment strategy and priorities.
Help identify and evaluate new investment capabilities, markets and opportunities where the General Account can generate differentiated value.
Represent Corporate Finance and the General Account with key internal stakeholders and external market participants.

Key Stakeholder Relationships

The Head Of Corporate Finance Works Closely With

General Account leadership
Portfolio Management
Credit
Investment Risk
Manulife Canada, Manulife Asia and John Hancock
Private Markets and other investment teams
Senior Finance and enterprise leadership
External borrowers, issuers, intermediaries and other market participants.
Success requires balancing strong independent investment judgment with the ability to operate collaboratively across investment disciplines, geographies and business units.

Required Qualifications

Deep expertise in corporate credit and investment-grade lending, ideally across both public and private markets.
Demonstrated experience leading a large and complex investment portfolio.
Strong understanding of credit underwriting, relative-value assessment, portfolio construction and risk management.
Experience operating across global markets and multiple currencies.
Strong commercial and investment judgment, including the ability to make effective decisions in complex or changing market environments.
Demonstrated ability to lead, develop and inspire senior investment professionals across multiple locations.
Strong executive presence and the ability to communicate complex investment matters clearly to senior leadership and investment governance forums.
Ability to collaborate effectively with portfolio managers, credit professionals and other investment teams while maintaining appropriate independence of judgment.
A track record of innovation and continuous improvement within an investment organization.

The role being advertised is an existing vacancy.

About Manulife And John Hancock

Manulife Financial Corporation is a leading international financial services provider, helping people make their decisions easier and lives better. To learn more about us, visit https://www.manulife.com/en/about/our-story.html.

Manulife is an Equal Opportunity Employer

At Manulife/John Hancock, we embrace our diversity. We strive to attract, develop and retain a workforce that is as diverse as the customers we serve and to foster an inclusive work environment that embraces the strength of cultures and individuals. We are committed to fair recruitment, retention, advancement and compensation, and we administer all of our practices and programs without discrimination on the basis of race, ancestry, place of origin, colour, ethnic origin, citizenship, religion or religious beliefs, creed, sex (including pregnancy and pregnancy-related conditions), sexual orientation, genetic characteristics, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital status, family status, disability, or any other ground protected by applicable law.

It is our priority to remove barriers to provide equal access to employment. A Human Resources representative will work with applicants who request a reasonable accommodation during the application process. All information shared during the accommodation request process will be stored and used in a manner that is consistent with applicable laws and Manulife/John Hancock policies. To request a reasonable accommodation in the application process, contact hr@manulife.com.

Working Arrangement

Hybrid
